#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
final="$root/versions/0.1.0-SNAPSHOT/ji-host"
failed="$root/versions/0.1.0-stage6-failed-health"
operation=$(printf '%s\n' "$root"/operations/install-0.1.0-stage6-failed-health-* | head -n 1)
test -x "$final/bin/ji-host"
systemctl --user stop ji-host.service
rm -f "$root/current.reset"
ln -s "$final" "$root/current.reset"
mv -Tf "$root/current.reset" "$root/current"
rm -f "$root/run/host-locator"
systemctl --user start ji-host.service
attempts=0
while ! test -f "$root/run/host-locator"; do attempts=$((attempts+1)); test "$attempts" -lt 60; sleep 1; done
rest=$(sed -n 's/^rest=//p' "$root/run/host-locator")
"$final/bin/ji-host" --health-check "http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready"
for directory in "$failed" "$operation"; do
  if test -d "$directory"; then
    docker run --rm -v "$directory:/ji-cleanup" alpine:3.22 sh -eu -c 'rm -rf /ji-cleanup/* /ji-cleanup/.[!.]* /ji-cleanup/..?*'
    rmdir "$directory"
  fi
done
rm -f "$root/incoming"/install-0.1.0-stage6-failed-health-*.tar.gz \
  "$root/incoming"/install-0.1.0-stage6-failed-health-*.tar.gz.manifest
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_FAILED_HEALTH_TEST_RESET
